India Eyes Sabang Port in Indonesia as Strategic Maritime Hub

India is reportedly considering a strategic partnership for the Sabang port in Indonesia, viewing it as a crucial new maritime frontier. This move comes after perceived setbacks in other port projects like Chabahar and Mongla. The development aims to enhance India's maritime presence and economic spillover in the Andaman Sea region.
